description: This file defines the FnStream class, which implements the StreamInterface. It allows for composing stream implementations based on a hash of functions, facilitating testing and extension without creating concrete subclasses.

classes.name: FnStream
classes.description: A class that composes stream implementations based on a hash of functions, enabling flexible extension and testing of stream behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FnStream with a hash of method names to callables and creates corresponding class functions.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Lazily determines which methods are not implemented, throwing an exception if accessed.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Calls the close function if defined when the object is destroyed.

methods.name: __wakeup
methods.description: Prevents unserialization of the object by throwing an exception.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Creates a new FnStream that decorates an existing StreamInterface, adding or proxying methods.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation by calling the __toString function.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Calls the close function.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Calls the detach function.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Calls the getSize function.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Calls the tell function.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Calls the eof function.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Calls the isSeekable function.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Calls the rewind function.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Calls the seek function with offset and whence.

methods.name: isReadable
